scheme_name: Rent Subsidy for Sales Emporia Established by Handicrafts / Micro & Small Industries Emporium
other_conditions: The applicant must own a Sales Emporium/Showroom located in Puducherry.
benefits_summary: Provides up to 90% rent subsidy (maximum ₹10,000 per month) and up to 75% reimbursement of infrastructure expenses (maximum ₹1,50,000) for three years.
documents_required: Prescribed format of the application form
Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attest, if required)
